**Average (median) house price in California (2024‑mid)**  
- **Median listing price:** ≈ $850 000  
- **Median sale price:** ≈ $830 000  

These figures come from the most recent quarterly reports by major real‑estate data providers (Zillow, Redfin, and the California Association of Realtors). The median is used because it represents the middle value of all transactions, giving a better sense of typical prices than a simple arithmetic mean, which can be skewed by a few very high‑priced properties.

> **Quick note:**  
> • The median price varies significantly by region—San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles are well above the state median, while many inland counties are below it.  
> • The median price has been rising steadily over the past decade, driven by limited inventory, high demand, and strong economic fundamentals in the state.  

If you need a more granular breakdown (by county, city, or ZIP code) or the latest quarterly update, let me know!
